content:
允許在擊敗Ignis後，讓[L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm)的Ignited Berserkers生成在[YUNG's Better Nether Fortresses](https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-better-nether-fortresses)中，從而實現兩款模組之間的兼容性。

（這僅需將Better Fortress結構添加至Cataclysm的"#berserker_spawn"標籤中即可）

當然，需要安裝L_Ender's Cataclysm、YUNG's Better Nether Fortresses及其依賴項。
